_comment: Cards that exist only for the filtered flash-permission test (tests/unit/casting/test_cast_as_though_flash_filter.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_myr_permission` is Shimmer Myr's second line alone, on a vanilla artifact with no flash of its own, so the filter is what is tested and not the body. `t_green_herald` is Yeva, Nature's Herald's two-key filter (green creature spells). The rest are the spells the filters are matched against: an artifact, an artifact creature, a green creature, a red creature and a green sorcery.

cards.name: Test Shimmer Permission
cards.oracle_text: You may cast artifact spells as though they had flash.

abilities.text: You may cast artifact spells as though they had flash.
